name: VideoVault Premiere Extension
releaseNotes:
- August 5, 2026
- adds a new full-resolution source checkout workflow for projects that need local 4K playback instead of proxy-only editing
- lets editors return a project back to server-linked source paths before handoff from the same panel
- shows clearer status when a project is still linked to local full-resolution files or needs recovery before handoff
- adds `Checkout Sources` so editors can mirror original source media into local VideoVault storage and switch the project onto those local files
- adds `Return To Server` so editors can relink managed clips back to NAS source paths before handing a project off
- tracks full-resolution source availability alongside existing proxy tracking so the panel can recover mixed or interrupted local-checkout states more clearly
- keeps the existing proxy workflow available for projects that still edit cleanly on proxies
- this release is intended to ship on both Windows and macOS
- teams moving between proxy work and full-resolution work should update all editor machines to the same release
